title: Cross-chain deposits will fail when the deposit token is the native token
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `crossChainMint()` function calculates the `_daoBalance` as:  ```solidity uint256 _daoBalance = IERC20(_daoDetails.depositTokenAddress).balanceOf(_daoAddress); ```  The problem is that the cross-chain DAO can be deployed with the native token (defined in the contract as address: `0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE`).
